#399 · Plump Mouse Pokémon

Bidoof

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Bidoof is a Normal-type Plump Mouse Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 20 kg. It evolves into Bibarel. Its highest base stat is HP (59), with a base stat total of 250.
